name: command-watchdog
description: PreToolUse hook that runs every Bash command under a watchdog (kills it if output and CPU progress both go flat for a sustained window, if a hard wall-clock cap is exceeded, or if the watchdog's own parent process has exited — orphaned children are killed within ~1-2s instead of running unsupervised), and runs rtk's own token-saving rewrite decision under the same supervision so rtk itself can never hang unsupervised.
